attempts.summary: Configured node1 (SONiC) as a VLAN access switch: eth1 (link to node2) is an untagged access port in VLAN 10, eth2 (link to node3) is an untagged access port in VLAN 20, using the kernel VLAN-filtering "Bridge" device (Ethernet* SAI ports are unbound on SONiC-VS, so eth1/eth2 are the real dataplane). Node1 also holds an L3 presence in each VLAN via Bridge.10 (192.168.10.1/24) and Bridge.20 (192.168.20.1/24) using bridge self-tagged VLAN entries, giving each host a working link to node1 inside its own VLAN while node2 and node3 cannot reach each other. Config was persisted (systemd oneshot service on node1 reapplying the bridge/VLAN state after boot; /etc/network/interfaces.d/ens7.cfg on node2/node3 for static addressing) and verified to survive a full one-at-a-time restart of all three nodes, with boot-id changes proving each reboot and post-reboot pings proving recovery of both connectivity and isolation.
